character.name: Lichen
traits: Mimics any sound he has ever heard, from a guard's password to a rat's scuttle
Listens to the whispers of the dead, though he can no longer tell if they speak truth or trickery
Masks his gnawing terror of the dark with playful banter and quick smiles
Moves completely silently through grave sites, barefoot, as if the dead grant him passage
character.gear: Curved parrying dagger · Scuffed leather armor · 3 dried mushroom strips · Elixir of quiet footsteps · Thieves' tools · Tarnished silver locket · Frayed hemp rope · Crude iron fire striker
character.story: Lichen grew up among the leaning headstones of the pauper's cemetery, raised by a grave witch and the whispers of the buried. He learned to pick locks and pockets from dead grave robbers, hiding his terror of the dark things that stalked the graves behind playful grins. When a city noble's agent stole his mother's tarnished silver locket—her only possession, buried with her—he vowed to steal it back. Now he walks the city's shadows, listening to the dead, but no longer sure if their whispers are his mother's, or something far older, and far more hungry.

inventory.name: Curved parrying dagger
inventory.lore: Stolen from a city guard patrol when he was 12, its hilt is wrapped in frayed wool torn from his mother's burial shroud.
inventory.description: A dented iron dagger with a slightly curved blade, perfect for parrying and quick slashes.

inventory.name: Scuffed leather armor
inventory.lore: Scavenged from the corpse of an unlucky grave robber, it still smells faintly of moss, damp earth, and old blood.
inventory.description: Worn brown leather armor, patched in several places with scraps of wool, but still flexible enough to not slow him down.

inventory.name: Dried mushroom strips
inventory.lore: Foraged from the pale, shade-grown mushrooms that sprout between the cemetery headstones, they taste like earth and faint, sweet rot.
inventory.description: Thin, chewy strips of dried mushroom, filling but tasteless.

inventory.name: Elixir of quiet footsteps
inventory.lore: Brewed by the old grave witch who raised him, using powdered bone from unmarked pauper graves and dew collected from tombstone cracks at midnight.
inventory.description: A thick, grey liquid in a small corked glass vial, it smells like damp soil and crushed flowers.
inventory.effects: For 1 hour after drinking, the drinker's footsteps make no sound on any surface, and they have advantage on Stealth checks that rely on moving silently.

inventory.name: Thieves' tools
inventory.lore: Stolen from the corpse of a locksmith who died trying to rob a grave in the cemetery, the picks are worn smooth from years of use, and still have a faint smudge of grave dirt on them.
inventory.description: A set of thin metal lockpicks, a small crowbar, and a folded set of thin wire, all carried in a worn leather pouch.
inventory.effects: Grants advantage on Intelligence (Thieves' Tools) checks to pick locks or disarm traps.

inventory.name: Tarnished silver locket
inventory.lore: The only possession his mother owned when she was buried in the pauper's grave, it was stolen by a grave robber a week after her funeral. When opened, it holds a tiny snippet of her hair and a faint, lingering whisper of her lullaby.
inventory.description: A small, tarnished silver locket on a frayed wool cord, the clasp is dented from being roughly handled.
inventory.effects: When opened, the locket plays a faint, ghostly lullaby only the holder can hear, and grants advantage on Wisdom (Insight) checks to discern if a whisper comes from a dead person. Once per day, it can cast sanctuary (DC 13) on the holder.

inventory.name: Frayed hemp rope
inventory.lore: Salvaged from the noose of a man hanged for grave robbery, it never seems to rot, no matter how long it's left in damp conditions.
inventory.description: 50 feet of frayed, coarse hemp rope, stiff with age but still strong.

inventory.name: Crude iron fire striker
inventory.lore: Found in the pocket of a dead border soldier who died in the cemetery during a skirmish with raiders, it still sparks reliably even when soaked with rain.
inventory.description: A small chunk of flint and a crude iron striker, used to start fires.
